description:
FILED s540a (Opus agent, 2026-11-13) from the CPAN board timing (#4787; docs/cpan-speed-comparison-s540.md section 4, the per-file table baselines/board-timing-s540.tsv; tool tools/board-timing.pl).  Times are CPU seconds, code 381d9063 (MAIN-READY-89), coarse pass load-normalised, lever A/Bs on a quiet box (heavy.sh bench, best of 3).

WHAT: %p-fasl-cache-enabled-p refuses a fasl while *pcl-fasl-build* is true (a nested load inside another module's compile pass), so that module loads from text; it gets its fasl only when a later run reaches its `use` outside a build.  Measured on a fresh cache, default policy, Log4perl t/040Filter.t (PCL_FASL_DEBUG): run 1 hit 0 / build 5 / text 27; run 2 hit 5 / build 1; run 3+ hit 6 (the 26 text loads left are #4961's :local modules).  Under PCL_COMPILE_DIRS='*' (#4961's lever) the chains are longer: TT config.t and Log4perl 040Filter.t were still building fasls at run 3.  On the board's warm (second) pass: cfile 33.2 s in 65 files / 21 dists.

LEVER: queue the module paths a nested load skipped and build their fasls after the outer build returns, in the same run.

DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT: the convergence count above (taken, scratch/s540a/STOP.md); after the fix a second run must show 0 fasl-builds for Log4perl 040Filter.t and TT config.t (also under '*').  Size: one session.

SECOND EXAMPLE (the precise pass, s540a): IO-Compress t/999pod.t (Test::Pod + Pod::Simple, installed modules) needed FIVE runs on its dist cache: cold 26.9 s CPU, run 2 10.7 s, run 3 5.4 s, run 4 5.6 s, run 5 1.0 s (scratch/s540a/precise-1.tsv rows 999pod.t: the best-of-3 spread of 457 % is this convergence, not noise).
=== s540 (2026-11-13) === handed to s540d at its launch (the same cache path as #4986 / #4987).
subject: PERF (CPAN board, 33 s in second runs): the module fasl cache needs one run PER NESTING LEVEL to converge -- a module first loaded INSIDE another module's fasl build loads from its text and gets its fasl only on a later run (Log4perl 040Filter.t: run 1 builds 5, run 2 builds 1, run 3 hits)
